items.question: What age must Emirati children be by 31 August to be admitted to the first year of Kindergarten (KG1) in UAE schools?
items.fact: KG1 admission age for Emirati children is 4 by 31 August

items.question: What is the minimum age a new student must be by 31 August to be admitted to Grade 1 in UAE public and private schools?
items.fact: Grade 1 new students must be at least 6 by 31 August
